(1) the proper motion dispersions in the Galactic bulge in the direction of the Galactic center are 3.4 mas/yr in Galactic longitude and 2.8 mas/yr in latitude, (2) the proper motion of the Sun relative to the bulge is (U_sun, V_sun, W_sun) = (-7.5 +/- 0.3, -10.5 +/- 1.0, -7.1 +/- 0.6) km
the proper-motion dispersions are the same in both the Plaut field and Baade's window, and that the proper motions are measurable down to V = 20.
the proper-motion dispersions are the same in Plaut's window and in Baade's Window.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are able to obtain proper-movements for stars down to the turnoff with a precision of better than 1 mas/year, and that the bulge proper motion dispersion in the direction of the Galactic plane is approximately 3 mas/yr.
we have demonstrated the feasibility of obtaining proper-motion measurements of stars in the bulge down to the main-sequence turn off with errors as low as 0.5-1 mas/yr.

we have shown that it is possible for a large-scale, wide-field survey of the Galactic bulges to be undertaken using photographic material, and that such a survey will provide a unique data base for the study of the Galactic bulg.
